description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The Computer Merchant, Ltd. is seeking a Software Developer to support engineering work in Tewksbury, Massachusetts; the end client is not identified. The role contributes to real-time embedded and application software through requirements analysis, design, development, testing, integration, documentation, reviews, and configuration management.
Software Developer designing, building, testing, and integrating embedded and application software, tools, and systems

Responsibilities:
• Responsibilities include participating in software requirements, design, development, and testing activities; creating or improving embedded software, application software, tools, and systems; and designing, coding, testing, and integrating software solutions
• You will document your work, contribute to internal reviews of software components and systems, and coordinate with project managers and engineering colleagues
• You will follow established development practices and processes, support configuration management, and contribute to quality and consistency throughout the software life cycle
• You may also work with team members to resolve technical challenges, validate software behavior, and support test automation activities as appropriate to the project

Requirements:
• software development experience
• Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills
• the ability to prepare clear technical documentation
• sound judgment

Preferred:
• data structures and algorithms, systems software design, operating systems, software architectures, and established development processes
• Experience working in a collaborative, team-based development environment
• Agile or Scrum practices, DevOps, and test automation
• collaborate constructively with colleagues who have different work and conflict-resolution styles
• A curiosity about emerging technologies and tools, along with the motivation to learn
